segments.t: Meanwhile in the corridor, Kostya asks Nastya what her parents said about her pregnancy, only to learn she is still hiding the news from her father. Listen to the full conversation in Russian first, and then we will walk through every line together.
Все равно ты пойдешь со мной.
Я не поеду на конную прогулку.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'What did your parents say?' Kostya raises the pitch on 'told' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question.
'Oh, nothing much.' Nastya anchors the line on 'yes', while 'nothing' completes the thought.
'I haven't told them yet.' The grammar packs 'I' and 'told' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Kostya answers right away.
'When will you tell them?' Kostya anchors the line on 'when', while 'will you say' completes the thought.
'Chef, will you look for a molecular cook?' The grammar packs 'Chef Barinov' and 'cook' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
Все равно ты пойдешь со мной.
'You will go out with me anyway.' Notice how Russian expresses 'all' and 'me' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Nastya answers right away.
'I will tell them tomorrow.' Notice how Russian expresses 'tomorrow' and 'will say' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'No, Dad, I cannot.' The meaning hinges on 'no' working together with 'can' in spoken Russian.
'I already took days off.' The '-a' ending on the past-tense verb for 'took' marks a female speaker or subject.
Я не поеду на конную прогулку.
'I am not going on a horseback ride.' Nastya brings out the contrast between 'I' and 'not' in a few short words.
'Alright, I have to go. Bye.' The grammar packs 'all' and 'for now' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Nastya, what horseback ride?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'Nastya' and finishing on 'walk'. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Все равно ты пойдешь со мной.
Я не поеду на конную прогулку.
That concludes the corridor conversation. Listen for Kostya's disbelief when Nastya has to turn down her father's horseback riding invitation. See you next time!
